notes: The marginal 'Or, pour thou not out my life' was read and set aside; the printed 'leave not my soul destitute' governs (rule 38).
Competing head at s013: 'leave' is defensible if the phrase is read as a plain verb with an adjectival complement, but the subtraction test of rules 31 and 44 puts the lexeme on 'destitute'.

The title divides by rule 57: יְהֹוִה takes 'O Jehovah', אֲדֹנָ takes 'the Lord' with its supplied determiner, and the lexicalized 1cs suffix is unrepresented, the ASV writing no possessive anywhere in the title.
